tracker.maine_remote: yes: Remote-first "Open Work" model: almost all Twilions are remote employees working from home or coworking spaces, with periodic in-person team gatherings and off-sites.
tracker.ai_summary: Twilio is a remote-first CPaaS leader; its V&V Media team matches the candidate's FDA-regulated verification background and telecom test interest. Maine-eligible remote work, but openings skew to engineering management rather than senior QA IC roles.
tracker.ai_red_flags: Only one V&V posting, and it is management-level; no senior IC QA roles visible. Twilio has a history of layoffs.
tracker.approach_role: Senior Engineering Manager, V&V Media (or VP of Engineering)
tracker.outreach_notes: As a 15-year test engineer with FDA-regulated V&V and C#/.NET automation experience, I can strengthen Twilio's Media V&V quality practice while working remotely from Maine.
